# Ting (Vincent) Lu

> Personal website of Ting (Vincent) Lu, who grew up in China and has lived in the Netherlands since 2015. Stories from work and from moving countries, notes, and what I am doing now.

- [Stories](https://vincentluting.github.io/stories/): a few stories from work
- [Writing](https://vincentluting.github.io/posts/): notes
- [Now](https://vincentluting.github.io/now/): what I am doing now
